svg.title: Swarm Brain — measured retrieval, LongMemEval-S
svg.text: Retrieval subtask, official public dataset, all 500 questions, no sampling. Measured 2026-08-07.
the labelled evidence sessions are inside the top ten of
roughly fifty candidate sessions 88.5% of the time
best measured configuration: fused ranking, dense lane off
in-memory kernel; hash embedder is not a semantic model
40 queries over 90 memories, shipped config: exact + FTS + trigram + dense ANN + graph, weighted RRF k = 60
Retrieval subtask — not comparable to published QA accuracy.
LongMemEval's published numbers are end-to-end QA accuracy with a reader model and an LLM judge.
This evaluation runs no reader. No comparison is made in either direction, and no state-of-the-art claim is made.
